subject.title: [Feature]: Add channels.signal.linkPreview config and pass-through to signal-cli JSON-RPC send

question: Should Signal link preview support allow `updateConfiguration` plus explicit preview-field pass-through, and what default, per-account, native/container, and linked-device semantics should `channels.signal.linkPreview` use?
rationale: The missing code path is clear, but the default behavior, primary-device failure mode, container parity, and untrusted metadata boundary are product/security choices rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Default-safe explicit pass-through
options.body: Add `channels.signal.linkPreview` only after defining per-account semantics, pass only caller-provided preview fields, and document native/container and primary-device limits.

options.title: Defer for security design
options.body: Keep the issue open until the linked preview-metadata prompt-injection boundary is settled, then implement Signal support against that policy.

options.title: Default-on previews
options.body: Enable previews by default and accept the higher compatibility and security review burden for existing Signal operators.

recommendation.title: Default-safe explicit pass-through
recommendation.body: Add `channels.signal.linkPreview` only after defining per-account semantics, pass only caller-provided preview fields, and document native/container and primary-device limits.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest Signal send/config/docs history and already left maintainer-facing context on this issue.
